- **Anil Sharma** – 40 % direct shareholding  
- **Priya Sharma** – 30 % direct shareholding  
- **Sharma Holdings LLP** – 30 % direct corporate shareholding  
- **Rakesh Sharma** – 18 % effective ownership (30 % × 60 %)
